items.title: Australian lawmaker has both legs amputated after allegedly deliberate attack by car rammer
items.brief: The Australian lawmaker hit by a car in an allegedly deliberate attack has now had both legs amputated, her husband announced Wednesday.

items.title: UK approves new gas field in the North Sea amid concerns about energy security
items.brief: The UK government has approved the development of a major new gas field in the North Sea as the war in the Middle East deepens concerns about energy security globally.

items.title: The Knicks raised a banner to the MSG rafters. Then LeBron James and the 76ers brought them back to earth
items.brief: The rafters themselves are nothing special, merely a useful space to house lighting and air conditioning.

items.title: Memphis leaders reject contentious 18-month pause on new data center development
items.brief: Memphis leaders rejected a contentious 18-month pause on new data center development in the city Tuesday, just two weeks after a meeting on the issue led to protests, calls to police and a fist fight at City Hall.

items.title: At the negotiating table and on the battlefield, Russia and Ukraine are at an impasse
items.brief: It’s like two theatrical performances unfolding side by side, before an audience of one.

items.title: NFL defends Eagles medical staff after Jalen Hurts played in London game with blood clot
items.brief: The NFL on Tuesday publicly and unequivocally defended how the Philadelphia Eagles managed the health of star quarterback Jalen Hurts after ultrasounds revealed blood clots had traveled to his lungs.
